title: Spin Shells on the Three-Sphere
subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
style: trureturing cyberpunk · a wave closing on a loop, the spin-shell ladder, three shell cards and a 2 × 2 dot split, even Chebyshev curves over κ, an exact character table, 3 × 5 dots regrouped as 3 + 5 + 7, a schematic heap bracket with shell blocks, the five d-orbital quadrupole ledger with d⁸ bars
summary: On the open line Fourier analysis needs π, e and a continuum of frequencies; closed into the three-sphere of unit quaternions, a wave must meet itself, and the spectrum becomes a ladder of spin shells j with (2j + 1)² functions each (the closing loop is schematic; the Peter–Weyl decomposition is a literature result, argued). Lean checks that on every compact group the finite unitary matrix entries are uniformly dense. The fidelity κ = w²/|p|² reads the first three shells as 1, 4κ (the squared spinor) and 4κ − 1; their reading as past, present and future is the book's model reading (argued); 4κ = 1 + (4κ − 1), 2 × 2 = 1 + 3, and at the integer rotor (1, 1, 1, 1) κ = 1/4 and χ₁ = 0 (computed). The whole-spin characters Eₙ(κ) follow the integer recursion with 4κ − 2 and are drawn over κ ∈ [0, 1]; Lean checks Eₙ(x²) = U₂ₙ(x) over the integers and E₂ = 16κ² − 12κ + 1 over finite rationals. An exact table at κ = 1, 3/4, 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 0 (computed) reads 1, 3, 5, 7 at κ = 1 and −11/9 for spin two at κ = 1/3; Lean checks that U₂ₙ₊₁(x) = x · oddFactorₙ(x²), and for p = (1, 1, 0, 0) the spinor character is ±√2 with square 2 (computed). Lean checks the fusion rule Eₘ Eₙ = Σ Eᵣ (r from |m − n| to m + n) for all m, n; the example E₁E₂ = E₁ + E₂ + E₃ = 64κ³ − 64κ² + 16κ − 1 and 3 × 5 = 3 + 5 + 7 are computed. The origin-free heap bracket y x̄ w and the shell-by-shell triple product f̂ⱼ ĝⱼ† ĥⱼ are a written derivation (argued, schematic picture). Finally the five real d orbitals form the j = 2 shell: their angular quadrupole diagonals are sevenths whose columns sum to zero (computed); Lean checks that the closed d¹⁰ shell vanishes on every axis and that emptying d_x²−y² leaves (−4/7, −4/7, +8/7) with zero trace; the gold oxidation states are the chapter's crystal-field background (argued).
summary_zh: 在敞开的直线上，傅里叶分析离不开 π、e 与连续频率；闭合成单位四元数构成的三维球面后，波必须首尾咬合，频谱化为一级级自旋壳 j，每壳携带 (2j + 1)² 个函数（闭合回路为示意；彼得—魏尔分解是文献结果，属论证）。Lean 内核检验：在任意紧群上，有限维幺正表示的矩阵元一致稠密。保真度 κ = w²/|p|² 把前三座壳读作 1、4κ（旋量平方核）与 4κ − 1；把它们读作过去、现在、未来是书中的模型诠释（论证）；4κ = 1 + (4κ − 1)、2 × 2 = 1 + 3，以及整数旋子 (1, 1, 1, 1) 处 κ = 1/4、χ₁ = 0 均为屏幕计算。整数自旋特征标 Eₙ(κ) 按含 4κ − 2 的整数递推生成，并在 κ ∈ [0, 1] 上画出；Lean 内核在整数上检验 Eₙ(x²) = U₂ₙ(x)，在有限有理数上检验 E₂ = 16κ² − 12κ + 1。κ = 1、3/4、1/2、1/3、1/4、0 处的精确表（屏幕计算）在 κ = 1 处读出 1、3、5、7，在 κ = 1/3 处自旋 2 为 −11/9；Lean 内核检验 U₂ₙ₊₁(x) = x · oddFactorₙ(x²)，p = (1, 1, 0, 0) 时旋量特征标为 ±√2、平方为 2（屏幕计算）。Lean 内核对一切 m、n 检验融合律 Eₘ Eₙ = Σ Eᵣ（r 从 |m − n| 到 m + n）；算例 E₁E₂ = E₁ + E₂ + E₃ = 64κ³ − 64κ² + 16κ − 1 与 3 × 5 = 3 + 5 + 7 为屏幕计算。无原点流群括号 y x̄ w 及逐壳矩阵三连乘 f̂ⱼ ĝⱼ† ĥⱼ 是书面推导（论证，示意图）。最后，五条实 d 轨道构成 j = 2 壳：角向四极对角元都是七分之几，每列之和为零（屏幕计算）；Lean 内核检验 d¹⁰ 闭壳在每条轴上归零，抽空 d_x²−y² 后余下 (−4/7, −4/7, +8/7) 且迹为零；金的氧化态属本章的配位场背景（论证）。
